analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc synthesis of three frozen native-versus-rational holdout comparisons; no refitting, retuning, new data or new experiment

rules.primary_fold_metric: RMSE exactly as recomputed from each frozen fold's held-out point predictions
rules.fold_comparison: Compare native and frozen rational-candidate RMSE within the same dataset and fold; exact equality is a tie, not a win
rules.overall_fold_winner: Compare native, frozen rational-candidate and frozen cubic-baseline RMSE within the same dataset and fold; retain exact ties
rules.point_comparison: Compare native and rational absolute residuals for the same stored observation; exact equality is a tie and no unavailable prediction may be discarded
rules.ratio: Native RMSE divided by rational-candidate RMSE within the same dataset and fold; all inputs must be finite and positive
rules.metric_disagreement: Retain folds where native-versus-rational direction under RMSE differs from direction under MAE or maximum absolute residual
rules.point_fold_disagreement: Retain folds where the unweighted majority of pointwise absolute-residual winners differs from the fold RMSE winner; ties exclude a fold from this diagnostic rather than forcing disagreement
rules.dataset_pooling: Within each dataset only, recompute native and rational metrics from all stored held-out point predictions and compare them with the frozen pooled metrics
rules.cross_dataset_pooling: Do not pool residuals, squared errors, RMSE, MAE or parameter values across datasets with different units and observation designs
rules.descriptive_counts: Fold-win and point-win counts may be displayed across the three datasets but are not independent Bernoulli trials, probabilities, effect sizes or universal model rankings
rules.known_answer: Preserve optimizer-known-answer status separately from certified-parameter forward evaluation and from all holdout results
rules.proof_scope: Do not transfer rational denominator, ellipsoid, parameter-box or continuous-safety certificates to any native model

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生三数据原生同折综合_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning, additional starts, changed folds or relaxed tolerances
No pooled cross-dataset error in raw or normalized units and no single scalar model score
No conversion of descriptive fold or point counts into probabilities, confidence intervals or universal rankings
No claim of independent wet-lab replication, independent model-family replication or new physical mechanism
No erasure of folds where rational or cubic models win, metric-direction disagreements or point-versus-fold disagreements
No native deterministic-bound, probability-calibration or transferred rational-certificate claim
No rewriting of the three frozen input files or their historical reports
